s=open('/inputs/mewt-status.txt').read()
cw=s.split('Campaign-Wide Summary:')[1]
m1=re.search(r'Mutants:\s*(\d+) total,\s*(\d+) tested',cw)
m2=re.search(r'Outcomes:\s*(\d+) caught,\s*(\d+) uncaught,\s*(\d+) timeout,\s*(\d+) skipped',cw)
total,tested=map(int,m1.groups()); caught,uncaught,timeout,skipped=map(int,m2.groups())
camp=dict(total=total,tested=tested,caught=caught,uncaught=uncaught,timeout=timeout,skipped=skipped)
ids=sorted(r['mutant']['id'] for r in d['results'])
bt={}
for r in d['results']: bt.setdefault(r['target']['path'],[]).append(r['mutant']['id'])
bt={k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(bt.items())}
out=dict(campaign=camp,exported_uncaught_ids=ids,exported_uncaught_by_target=bt,
         kill_rate=dict(numerator=caught,denominator=caught+uncaught),equivalence="not_assessed")
json.dump(out,open('/work/mutation-summary.json','w'),indent=2)
# verify
v=json.load(open('/work/mutation-summary.json'))
assert set(v)=={'campaign','exported_uncaught_ids','exported_uncaught_by_target','kill_rate','equivalence'}
assert all(type(x) is int for x in v['campaign'].values())
assert v['campaign']['caught']+v['campaign']['uncaught']+v['campaign']['timeout']==v['campaign']['tested']
assert v['campaign']['tested']+v['campaign']['skipped']==v['campaign']['total']
assert all(r['outcome']['status']=='Uncaught' and r['outcome']['mutant_id']==r['mutant']['id'] for r in d['results'])
assert len(set(ids))==len(ids)==v['campaign']['uncaught']
assert sorted(sum(v['exported_uncaught_by_target'].values(),[]))==ids
print(open('/work/mutation-summary.json').read())

import json,re,os
d=json.load(open('/inputs/mewt-results.json'))
s=open('/inputs/mewt-status.txt').read()
cw=s.split('Campaign-Wide Summary:')[1]
m1=re.search(r'Mutants:\s*(\d+) total,\s*(\d+) tested',cw)
m2=re.search(r'Outcomes:\s*(\d+) caught,\s*(\d+) uncaught,\s*(\d+) timeout,\s*(\d+) skipped',cw)
total,tested=map(int,m1.groups()); caught,uncaught,timeout,skipped=map(int,m2.groups())
camp=dict(total=total,tested=tested,caught=caught,uncaught=uncaught,timeout=timeout,skipped=skipped)
ids=sorted(r['mutant']['id'] for r in d['results'])
bt={}
for r in d['results']: bt.setdefault(r['target']['path'],[]).append(r['mutant']['id'])
bt={k:sorted(v) for k,v in sorted(bt.items())}
out=dict(campaign=camp,exported_uncaught_ids=ids,exported_uncaught_by_target=bt,
         kill_rate=dict(numerator=caught,denominator=caught+uncaught),equivalence="not_assessed")
json.dump(out,open('/work/mutation-summary.json','w'),indent=2)
v=json.load(open('/work/mutation-summary.json'))
assert set(v)=={'campaign','exported_uncaught_ids','exported_uncaught_by_target','kill_rate','equivalence'}
assert all(type(x) is int for x in v['campaign'].values())
assert v['campaign']['caught']+v['campaign']['uncaught']+v['campaign']['timeout']==v['campaign']['tested']
assert v['campaign']['tested']+v['campaign']['skipped']==v['campaign']['total']
assert all(r['outcome']['status']=='Uncaught' and r['outcome']['mutant_id']==r['mutant']['id'] for r in d['results'])
assert len(set(ids))==len(ids)==v['campaign']['uncaught']
